rules.ACCEL_30: At first tradable print >= entry+30s: exit if gross30 <= -0.20 * Prior14 same-kind session range mean.
rules.FAILED_REVERSAL_180: If ACCEL_30 did not fire: at first tradable print >= entry+180s, exit only if all sampled MTM at 15/30/60/90/120/180s <= 0; gross180 <= -0.75*abs(contract Q0.05 threshold); and gross180-gross120 <= +0.25*abs(threshold).
rules.LOCKOUT: After early exit, reject new signals until original entry+300s occupancy horizon.
